lines.zh: 我借着一股上升气流滑行。
lines.en: I ride a rising current of air.
My wingtips barely clear the ridge.
I circle above the snowline.

lines.zh: 风把我的羽毛梳向后方。
lines.en: The wind combs my feathers back.
One beat of my wings lifts me higher.
I follow the shape of the cliff face.

lines.zh: 石峰之间，我找了个缺口。
lines.en: I found a gap between the stone peaks.
I hang motionless in the warm updraft.
My shadow sweeps across the grassy slope.

lines.zh: 我斜着穿过风袭的草原。
lines.en: I cut across the wind-swept savanna.
Wings spread, I need hardly any effort.

lines.zh: 我落到岩台上，爪先着地。
lines.en: I land on a rock ledge, talons first.
I fold my wings and stand in the wind.
I watch the movement below the mountain.
The clouds below the cliff churn fast.

lines.zh: 羽毛被风吹得乱了一点。
lines.en: The wind has ruffled my feathers a little.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，扫过整片山谷。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, sweeping the valley.

lines.zh: 这里高得听不见别的声音。
lines.en: It is so high here that nothing else can be heard.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣紧岩石的裂口。
lines.en: My talons grip a crack in the rock.

lines.zh: 一只兔子在很远的地方动。
lines.en: A rabbit moves very far below.
I wait for the wind to stop, or to rise.
The sun makes my back hot.

lines.zh: 我眯着眼，瞳孔收得很小。
lines.en: I squint, pupils drawn to pinpoints.
I hone my beak on the rock until it gleams.

lines.zh: 天边有一点黑色在移动。
lines.en: There is a fleck of black moving at the horizon.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，落下一根绒毛。
lines.en: I shake myself and a down feather falls.

lines.zh: 这风口是我惯常的位置。
lines.en: This windy ledge is my usual perch.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和风声混在一起。
lines.en: My breathing blends with the wind.
I do not call out; I only watch.
Another eagle circles in the distance.

lines.zh: 你爬上这么高来做什么？
lines.en: What brings you up this high?
From the ridge you look very small.
I know that thing in your hand.

lines.zh: 翅膀一展，你就不算高了。
lines.en: One spread of my wings and you are no longer high.
You are standing in my air current.
I do not fear you; I fear your bow.

lines.zh: 你抬头太久了，脖子会酸。
lines.en: You have looked up too long; your neck will ache.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段悬崖。
lines.en: A stretch of cliff lies between us.

lines.zh: 你要上来，还是让我下去？
lines.en: Will you climb up, or shall I come down?

lines.zh: 我在这道山脊上盘旋，看得见你。
lines.en: Circling this ridge, I can see you.

lines.zh: 我歪头，把你的位置记牢。
lines.en: I cock my head and fix your position.

lines.zh: 这山风会把你吹回去的。
lines.en: This mountain wind will drive you back.

lines.zh: 你的手指在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Your fingers are moving; I saw.
This rock does not welcome guests.

lines.zh: 你若伸手，我的爪子会先到。
lines.en: Reach out and my talons arrive first.

lines.zh: 我见过太多举着火把的人。
lines.en: I have seen too many people holding torches.
Feathers scatter and my balance slips.
A shriek breaks against the cliff wall.

lines.zh: 这一下打折了我半边翅。
lines.en: That numbed half a wing.
I flap and hop backward.
Beads of blood fall on the rock.

lines.zh: 我稳住爪子，才没栽下去。
lines.en: I grip with my talons and barely keep from falling.
The pain keeps me from folding my wing.

lines.zh: 峭壁的风记下了你的味。
lines.en: The cliff wind has learned your scent.
I pant with my beak open, its corners quivering.

lines.zh: 飞起来会疼，但我还是飞。
lines.en: Flying will hurt, and still I fly.
Raw chicken? That is a heavy thing to carry up here.
Set the meat down and step back.
The smell of meat rides the wind up to me.

lines.zh: 我歪头，看那块肉，也看你。
lines.en: I tilt my head, at the meat and at you.

lines.zh: 幼鸟时我也是这样被驯的。
lines.en: That is how I was tamed as a chick.
That will not fill my crop.

lines.zh: 我可以下来，也可以不下来。
lines.en: I may come down, or I may not.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的鸡肉，爪子松开。
lines.en: I stare at the chicken in your hand and loosen my grip.

lines.zh: 鸡肉的香味压过了石头味。
lines.en: The scent of chicken overtakes the stone.
Give it to me, then walk a little away.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀硬，我的骨头轻。
lines.en: Your shoulder is hard; my bones are light.
The bump knocked me off balance.
Do not reach out on a ridge.
I flap to steady myself.
That jostle shook loose a few feathers.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一小块岩台上。
lines.en: We are crowded on one small ledge.
My wing bones smart from the knock.

lines.zh: 你再推，我们都会掉下去。
lines.en: Push again and we shall both fall.
I fold my wings and step aside.
I let out a low hiss.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着上升气流飞。
lines.en: We fly side by side on the same thermal.
I trace a wide circle around you.

lines.zh: 高处那处崖缝，可以筑巢。
lines.en: That cleft high up would do for a nest.

lines.zh: 我们把枯枝一根根叼上去。
lines.en: We carry twigs up one by one.
I spread my wings, and so do you.
We turn facing each other in the wind.

lines.zh: 山风再大也吹不散我们。
lines.en: No mountain gust can blow us apart.
Two eggs lie in the nest, heavy.
You keep the nest; I will hunt.

lines.zh: 明年还在这块石峰上见。
lines.en: Same peak next year.
I stoop and snatch, talons closing.

lines.zh: 猎物离地的那一下最轻。
lines.en: The moment prey leaves the ground is the lightest.
This dry branch will pad the nest.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，飞起来有点偏。
lines.en: Carrying it, my flight tilts a little.
Too small to bother descending.

lines.zh: 我抓住它，又松开看它掉。
lines.en: I grab it, then let it drop to watch.
Talons hold things better than hands do.
This thing is still moving in my grip.
I take it up high before eating.
Feathers and bones all go into the nest.
That chicken — I have already seen it.
I tuck my wings and take aim.
Snakes are on my menu too.
A rabbit's speed will not save it.
You are too close to the nest.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你头顶那条线。
lines.en: I have locked the line above your head.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去，抓起兔子再抛。
lines.en: I dive, grab a rabbit, and drop it.

lines.zh: 从这个高度，没什么能躲。
lines.en: From this height nothing can hide.
Small target, just right to carry.
One stoop is all it takes.

lines.zh: 我盘旋着，一圈比一圈近。
lines.en: I circle, each pass a little closer.
You can look up and still not find me.
The sun is behind me — good.
I wait for your steps to falter.

lines.zh: 我数着你还有几步到空地。
lines.en: I count the paces until you reach open ground.

lines.zh: 风的方向帮我压低声音。
lines.en: The wind direction muffles my approach.
I bank to make my shadow smaller.
The target is still moving; I am patient.
My talons have already opened.
If you mean to run, now is the time.
I stoop, talons arriving first.
Grab, lift, then let go.

lines.zh: 你被我从地上拔了起来。
lines.en: I have plucked you off the ground.
A drop from this height will hurt.
My beak strikes your shoulder.
My wings sweep and dust flies up.
I wobble while you struggle.

lines.zh: 我又升了一截，你更重了。
lines.en: I climb again, and you feel heavier.
The shadow below grows larger.

lines.zh: 我松开爪，剩下的交给地面。
lines.en: I open my talons and leave the rest to the ground.

lines.zh: 热气流托着我升上山脊。
lines.en: A thermal lifts me over the ridge.

lines.zh: 冰封的山峰上，有我的巢。
lines.en: On the frozen peak lies my nest.

lines.zh: 风先刮起，然后我才出现。
lines.en: First the wind rises; then I appear.

lines.zh: 石峰的尖顶是我的落脚处。
lines.en: The stone spire is my foothold.
I spiral up on the warm air.
A shadow passes over the savanna.

lines.zh: 崖边传来我翅膀的破风声。
lines.en: The crack of my wings carries along the cliff.
I land on a rock corner and look around.
The clouds are close here.
The cold wind pales my feathers.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声长啸是我。
lines.en: That long cry you heard was mine.
The thin high air keeps me sharp.

lines.zh: 羽毛烧起来，我赶紧扑打。
lines.en: My feathers catch fire and I beat at them.

lines.zh: 我撞在崖壁上，一路滑下去。
lines.en: I struck the cliff and slid down.

lines.zh: 水面盖住我，翅膀沉得抬不起来。
lines.en: Water closes over me and my wings will not lift.
The blast hurls me far off course.
That arrow tore through my wing.

lines.zh: 一股诡异的力量压住了我的翅。
lines.en: An unnatural force weighs down my wings.

lines.zh: 雪封了山，好几天没吃东西。
lines.en: Snow has sealed the mountain and I have not eaten in days.

lines.zh: 闪电劈在峰顶，我浑身一炸。
lines.en: Lightning splits the peak and jolts through me.

lines.zh: 没有气流了，我直往下掉。
lines.en: The air is gone and I fall straight down.
